Question ID: MAR_U05_L04_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.IMP.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Marine Conservation and Restoration
Stimulus: Conservation/restoration case

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the impact or decision. Then use the required stimulus (Conservation/restoration case) to connect the visible evidence to human impacts, fisheries, conservation, monitoring, policy, and sustainability decisions. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.IMP.03 and avoids this common mistake: choosing the solution that sounds best without weighing marine evidence and tradeoffs.
